# stalwart_metadata (Data Source)

Configures object metadata: JMAP metadata, WebDAV dead properties and IMAP annotations. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data_types` (Set of String) JMAP data types that support the metadata and privateMetadata properties
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `imap_server_admin` (String) URI for contacting the server administrator (for example mailto:postmaster@example.org), returned to IMAP clients as the /shared/admin server annotation
- `imap_server_comment` (String) Comment returned to IMAP clients as the /shared/comment server annotation
- `max_depth` (Number) Maximum nesting depth of a JMAP metadata namespace value. Leave empty for no limit
- `max_entries` (Number) Maximum number of entries in the metadata of an object
- `max_entry_size` (Number) Maximum size of a single entry: a JMAP namespace value, a WebDAV dead property or an IMAP annotation
- `max_private_size` (Number) Maximum size of the private metadata a user stores on an object
- `max_query_scan` (Number) Maximum number of annotated objects a JMAP query scans to evaluate a metadata text condition. Queries above this limit reject text conditions
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum size of the shared metadata of an object
- `private_metadata` (Boolean) Whether users may store private metadata that only they can see
- `vendor_namespaces` (Boolean) Whether JMAP clients may store metadata under vendor (domain name) namespaces
